scope: Pinned DSBI TRAIN-only parser/source assessment. No model, inference, optimizer, training manifest changes, test-image pixels or accuracy claim.

geometry.cell_box_margin: .3 times horizontal dot-column pitch on all four sides; source coordinates remain unclipped

limitations: The dataset contains 200-dpi flatbed scans, not handheld camera captures.
DSBI TRAIN has only four source families; the 88 TEST images remain untouched.
Mask zero is explicit background; unlisted grid slots are not synthesized as labeled cells.
The .3-pitch margin is a primary implementation convention, not a measured per-image dot radius.
The actual annotated middle grid line is retained; the pinned upstream optional point mode uses the integer midpoint instead.
Grid coordinate bounds alone do not certify optical alignment; representative visual review follows separately.
